integrity: An unrestricted self-contained proof is supplied. Finite enumeration is independently programmed as a check; it is not substituted for an infinite-domain proof. All comparison sources and residual historical-priority risks are stated.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the static VC dimension of single-pair comparison traces under a fixed finite strict poset, not Littlestone dimension, adaptive identification, whole-poset queries, or probabilistic models. No external audit and no conclusive exhaustive priority survey.
title: Comparison shattering for linear extensions of finite posets
